messages.content: I need to delete some columns from my employees database on personal_data table. I want to remove their email addresses and social security numbers to respect privacy.

operation.description: The operation to carry out on the table. Can be 'delete' or 'add'.

columns.description: List of the columns to add or delete from the table.

function.name: database_create_backup
function.description: This function creates a backup of the database before modification Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

db_name.description: The name of the database to create a backup of.

backup_location.description: The file path where the backup should be stored.

timestamp.description: Option to append a timestamp to the backup file name.
